headline: Approved conditional use permit for a personal fitness studio at 381 Main Street, Unit 2.
summary: The permit was approved 7-0 with a condition that outstanding Engineering Department comments be addressed to the satisfaction of the Division of Public Works. A waiver of the site plan requirement was also approved. Two appointments were tabled until December 3.
decisions: Approved the minutes of October 15, 2026, 6-0-1, with Mr. Green abstaining.
Approved a waiver of the requirement to provide a site plan for a conditional use application, 7-0.
Approved conditional use permit for a personal fitness studio at 381 Main Street, Unit 2, 7-0, with a condition on Engineering Department comments.
Found the tentative agenda had no proposals of regional impact, 7-0.
Tabled the appointment of a board member to the Nashua Regional Planning Commission Executive Committee until December 3.
Tabled the appointment of a board member to the Historic District Commission until December 3.
Accepted the 2027 meeting and deadline dates, with the July 5 meeting dates changed to July 15, 2026.

RECORD OF WRITTEN DECISION 
NCPB MEETING NOVEMBER 19, 2026 
 
1 
 
MAYOR DONCHESS  DAN HUDSON (City Eng.)    
JOE MACINTYRE X LARRY HIRSCH                  X 
BOB BOLLINGER, CHAIR X MAGGIE HARPER (Alt.)        
ADAM VARLEY, VICE CHAIR X PATRICIA KLEE (Ald.)        X 
CAMERON GREEN, CLERK    X AMBER MORGAN (Alt. Ald)  
BENJAMIN ZOLLER   X SCOTT LECLAIR         
****************************************************************************** 
PLANNING STAFF ATTENDANCE 
Sam Durfee    X Scott McPhie                X Connor Muise  X 
****************************************************************************** 
APPROVAL OF MINUTES – October 15, 2026 
 
MOTION BY: Alderman Klee SECONDED BY: Mr. Zoller 
 
VOTE:  6-0-1 Mr. Green Abstained 
 
COMMUNICATIONS 
 
• A26-0203, 381 Main St 
o Updated Engineering comments 
• Discussion Item: Presentation 
 
REPORT OF CHAIRMAN, COMMITTEE, AND LIASON  
 
None
RECORD OF WRITTEN DECISION 
NCPB MEETING NOVEMBER 19, 2026 
 
2 
 
NEW BUSINESS – CONDITIONAL USE PERMITS 
A26-0203    FMP Realty, LLC (Owner), Nick Braley (Applicant) requesting Conditional 
Use Permit approval for a personal fitness studio. Property is located at 381 Main Street, 
Unit 2. Map 109 Lot 7. Zoned A-Urban Residence (R-A). Ward 6. 
 
MOTION TO TAKE JURISDICTION: Yes  
 
MOTION BY:  Alderman Klee SECONDED BY: Mr. Hirsch 
 
VOTE: 7-0 
 
WAIVERS 
 
MOTION TO: Approve 
MOTION BY:  Mr. Green     SECONDED BY: Alderman Klee    
 
a. §190-271: To waive the requirement to provide a site plan for a conditional use 
application. 
 
As per RSA 674:36(II)(N), RSA 674:44(III)(e), and §190-148(D), Strict conformity would pose 
an unnecessary hardship to the Applicant and the waiver would not be contrary to the spirit and 
intent of the regulations; and specific circumstances, or conditions of the land, and the waiver will 
properly carry out the spirit and intent of the regulations.  
 
VOTE: 7-0 
 
CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT 
 
MOTION TO: Approve 
MOTION BY:  Mr. Green   SECONDED BY: Mr. Hirsch 
 
a) All outstanding comments from the Engineering Department shall be addressed to the 
satisfaction of the Division of Public Works. 
 
VOTE: 7-0
RECORD OF WRITTEN DECISION 
NCPB MEETING NOVEMBER 19, 2026 
 
3 
 
OTHER BUSINESS 
 
1. Review of tentative agenda to determine proposals of regional impact. 
 
MOTION: No  
 
MOTION BY:  Mr. Zoller     SECONDED BY: Mr. Varley   
 
VOTE: 7-0 
2. Appoint board member to Nashua Regional Planning Commission Executive Committee 
  Table to December 3 
3. Appoint board member to Historic District Commission 
  Table to December 3 
 
4. 2027 Meeting and Deadline Dates  
  Accept the meeting dates with the exception of changing the July 5 meeting dates 
to July 15, 2026.  
 
DISCUSSION ITEMS   
 
Connor Muise – Presented updates on the Code for approval criteria. 
 
 
NONPUBLIC SESSION  
 
The Planning Board will need to make a motion to enter into a Nonpublic Session under RSA 91-
A:3, II (e) for consideration or negotiation of pending claims or litigation which has been 
threatened in writing or filed against the public body.  
 
NEXT MEETING:  December 3, 2026 
 
ADJOURN  
 
MOTION by Alderman Klee at 8:32 PM 
 
MOTION CARRIED 7-0
